findings.claim: The production build emits raw engine module identifiers, which can disclose absolute build-host paths in a deployed static asset.
findings.evidence: The plugin serializes Object.keys(chunk.modules) unchanged as engineModules and emits the result to .vite/markdown-engine-graph.json; Rollup/Vite module identifiers commonly contain absolute node_modules paths, and no normalization or post-verification removal is present in the packet.
findings.suggested_fix: Normalize matched module IDs to package-relative identifiers before serialization, or keep the raw graph outside the deployable output and emit only a sanitized verification summary into production artifacts.
